edges.mechanism: Possible potentiation of anticoagulation; in rats astaxanthin lowered vitamin K and vitamin K-dependent factors (II, VII, IX, X) and prolonged PT/aPTT
edges.evidence: One human case report (INR 1.4 -> 10.38 with ecchymosis, causality probable) plus animal data; no controlled human study

edges.mechanism: Theoretical additive anticoagulant effect: suppression of hepatic coagulation-factor transcription and of vitamin K-dependent factors (animal)
edges.evidence: Animal/in vitro mechanistic data plus one warfarin case report

edges.mechanism: Astaxanthin inhibited platelet aggregation, adhesion and integrin activation via ROS-PI3K/Akt/mTOR and MAPK/ERK; additive effect theoretical
edges.evidence: Animal and human-platelet in vitro data only; no excess bleeding in animal models
Single small RCTs showed lower SBP; meta-analysis showed no significant BP effect; theoretical
MA of carotenoid RCTs: astaxanthin/fucoxanthin FBG -4.36 mg/dL in T2D (very low certainty); fructosamine reduced in one RCT

edges.mechanism: Orlistat reduces absorption of beta-carotene and fat-soluble vitamins; astaxanthin is lipophilic and its absorption is fat-dependent, so reduced absorption is expected
edges.evidence: Extrapolation from FDA label (beta-carotene) and human PK showing fat dependence; not directly studied

edges.mechanism: Lipid co-ingestion/formulation increases oral bioavailability of the lipophilic carotenoid
edges.evidence: Human PK: lipid-based formulations 1.7-3.7x bioavailability; micellar form higher, faster Cmax

edges.mechanism: Both lower triglycerides and raise HDL-C; possible additive lipid effects
edges.evidence: Indirect: separate pooled estimates in one MA of antioxidant lipid supplements; combination not tested
Animal data plus one human bleeding case on warfarin

edges.mechanism: Supplement (8 mg/day) plus background diet exceeds EFSA ADI of 0.2 mg/kg bw (by 28% at 10-<14 y, up to 524% in infants)
edges.evidence: EFSA NDA Panel opinion (regulatory exposure assessment)

edges.mechanism: True pharmacodynamic change (not assay artifact) when combined with warfarin; PT/aPTT prolonged in rats
Small true ALT increase reported (not assay interference)
edges.evidence: MA of 5 RCTs: ALT +1.92 U/L; carotenoid MA (2025) found no significant overall change
